steps.title: There are 2 paths you can …
steps.text: There are 2 paths you can take beyond Corrupted Gauntlet, and they will both lead to raiding. One of them is the Blade of Saeldar Route & the other Noxious Halberd Rush. I would only recommend the Blade Route if you enjoy Corrupted Gauntlet, but the Noxious Halberd Route may require alts to effectively do and may be a bit more boring but both are routed below and are very similar. (I did the Blade route so the Halberd Route is theorycrafted rather than tested. The guide will mention when you detour BUT if you are doing Blade Route, DO NOT make a Blade before the BOFA. You will be staying until 2x Enhanced Weapon Seeds.
